zh.title: 日全蝕影響航情與飛行操作 飛行員依夜航程序因應
zh.summary: 8月12日日全蝕致光線驟降；儀表航班需因應視景變化；近地警告須執行夜航程序
body: 8月12日星期三將出現日全蝕天象，全蝕帶沿西伯利亞至格陵蘭、西班牙北部及巴利亞利群島延伸，局部地區全蝕持續時間最長達2分18秒。當日全蝕使白天短暫轉為陰暗時，在全蝕帶內依儀表飛行規則（IFR）運作的民航機將面臨自然光線快速衰減的情況，環境亮度可能迅速降至接近黃昏或夜間狀態。
在飛行操作方面，客機的飛行管理系統、導航及飛行控制系統在日全蝕期間均保持正常運作。巡航階段的航班因主要仰賴儀表飛行，受光線變化影響相對有限；然而在起飛或進場階段，外界環境光線急劇減少可能顯著改變視覺環境，跑道及進場燈光將更加顯眼，飛行員須嚴格依據適用的儀表進場程序與公告的最低氣象條件執行操作。
日全蝕所導致的光線暗轉亦涉及夜間飛行程序的適用問題。若航班在全蝕期間接獲近地警告系統（GPWS）的警報，由於視線與地形目視能力受限，飛行員預計將執行針對夜間情境設定的復原避讓程序。此外，部分機場在夜間對精確進場軌跡燈（PAPI）的使用設有強制規定，航空公司亦可能依據夜間降落限制制定相關營運規範。
安全指引同時特別強調對飛行員視覺保護的要求。飛行員若在未配戴適當眼睛防護裝備的情況下直接觀測日全蝕，不論是偏蝕階段或接近全蝕階段，均可能造成永久性視網膜損傷。機組人員須遵循日全蝕觀測安全規範，並可於天象發生前向乘客進行相關安全宣導。
除了天象本身的影響外，日全蝕亦可能引發區域性航空交通量增加。過往日全蝕經驗顯示，大量通用航空與私人飛機可能前往全蝕帶空域觀看天象，進而提高區域空域交通繁忙度，增加當地空中交通管制服務負擔及鄰近機場擁塞程度。民航主管機關得採取臨時空域限制或特殊管控程序以維護空域秩序。

en.title: Pilots Prepare for Flight Operational Impacts During August 12 Total Solar Eclipse
en.summary: Pilots face daylight changes during the August 12 solar eclipse; GPWS cautions require night recovery procedures
body: A total solar eclipse on Wednesday, 12 August 2026, will briefly plunge a portion of the Earth into darkness. The path of totality will extend along a strip from Siberia to Greenland, northern Spain, and the Balearic Islands, with the eclipse producing a period of totality lasting up to around two minutes and 18 seconds depending on the observation location.

For commercial aircraft operating under instrument flight rules within the path of totality, daylight will fade rapidly as the Moon passes across the Sun, creating conditions resembling dusk or nighttime. Aircraft flight management, navigation, and flight control systems will continue operating normally. While cruising flights face limited operational impact due to instrument navigation, departing and landing aircraft may experience significant changes in external visual environments and ambient light levels.

The sudden drop in daylight raises specific considerations regarding night flying rules and safety procedures. If a ground proximity warning system caution occurs during totality, flight crews are expected to execute terrain recovery procedures established for nighttime conditions. Operational requirements at certain airports, such as mandatory night use of precision approach path indicator lights, as well as airline-specific night landing policies, may also apply during the event.

Safety guidelines highlight visual hazard risks for flight crews attempting to observe the celestial event directly. Looking at the Sun without certified protective eyewear during partial phases or totality can cause permanent retinal damage. Pilots and flight crews are required to adhere to eye safety protocols and may communicate viewing safety recommendations to passengers prior to totality.

Beyond flight deck operations, the eclipse is anticipated to generate localized surges in aviation traffic. Historical eclipse events have drawn significant numbers of general aviation and private aircraft positioning within the path of totality. The increased flight activity could cause airport congestion and heighten demand on local air traffic control services, prompting aviation authorities to implement temporary airspace restrictions or special traffic management procedures.

facts.claim: A total solar eclipse on Wednesday, 12 August 2026, will briefly plunge parts of Earth into darkness.
facts.sourceQuote: A total eclipse will briefly plunge a sliver of the Earth into darkness on Wednesday 12 August.

facts.claim: The total eclipse will be best observed along a path extending from Siberia to Greenland, northern Spain, and the Balearic Islands, with totality lasting up to two minutes and 18 seconds.
facts.sourceQuote: best observed along a strip of Earth’s surface from Siberia to Greenland and on to northern Spain and the Balearic Islands, where a total eclipse will take place.

facts.claim: For commercial aircraft under instrument flight rules in the path of totality, daylight will fade rapidly, altering the visual environment during departure or landing.
facts.sourceQuote: For commercial aircraft under instrument flight rules operating within the path of totality, daylight will fade rapidly as the Moon moves across the Sun, creating conditions that will feel like dusk or even nighttime.

facts.claim: If a ground proximity warning system caution occurs during an eclipse, pilots are expected to execute nighttime recovery procedures.
facts.sourceQuote: Were such a caution to occur during an eclipse, the expectation would be that the recovery procedure for a nighttime situation be executed.

facts.claim: Observing the Sun directly without eye protection during an eclipse can cause permanent retinal damage to flight crews.
facts.sourceQuote: Looking at the Sun without appropriate eye protection can cause permanent retinal damage.

facts.claim: Increased general aviation traffic along the path of totality may cause airport congestion and lead authorities to introduce temporary airspace restrictions.
facts.sourceQuote: Authorities can introduce temporary airspace restrictions or special procedures to manage the additional traffic.
